# GRYOnline — Polish contemporary review

- Original source: [GRYOnline — Polish contemporary review](https://www.gry-online.pl/recenzje/robin-hood-legenda-sherwood-recenzja-gry/zc4ce)
- Author / publication: Andrzej Jerzyk / GRYOnline
- Language / date: Polish; 2003-03-10
- Access: Article text inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Jerzyk particularly enjoys the partly open campaign order and the connection between squad selection, training, and supply production. Different workers produce different supplies, making it difficult to keep every useful specialist in the field.

The review discusses combat gestures, the danger of hitting allies, and the vulnerability of a character while preparing an attack. Its closing assessment stresses the difference between relaxed play on low difficulty and careful planning at higher settings.

The author says this control style was new to him, providing a useful newcomer perspective. He would have liked multiplayer and a mission editor. This is a separate publication from the site's walkthrough already collected here.
